title: Which Workshop Invoices Count Towards Further Cost on a Claim
content:
Which of the workshop's invoices on a vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan count towards the further cost on a claim turns on the vehicle's standing under a Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan and on how often it has been in the workshop.

- Where the vehicle carries an active care plan and two or more workshop visits on it stand in the three months before, the work counted is what the workshop has invoiced on the vehicle in the six months before.
- Where the vehicle carries an active care plan and fewer than two workshop visits stand in that period, the work counted is the largest single invoice the workshop has raised on the vehicle.
- Where the vehicle carries no active care plan, the work counted is what the workshop has invoiced in the three months before.

### Input, judgement, output (hypothetical figures)

Suppose the workshop has raised invoices of 900, 700 and 400 on the vehicle, the first two inside the three months before and the third five months before.

| Care plan | Visits in the three months before | Work counted |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 2 | 2000, the invoices of the six months before totalled |
| Active | 1 | 900, the largest single invoice raised |
| None | any | 1600, the invoices of the three months before totalled |

The second reading looks to the largest invoice the workshop has raised on the vehicle at any time, not merely the largest inside a window.

### Records consulted

The care plan's standing and the workshop's invoices and visits are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan held on that vehicle.
